description.value: LURE Restaurant & Bar occupies a prime position on Victoria's Inner Harbour, serving a West Coast seasonal menu built around local seafood, Vancouver Island produce, and craft cocktails made with local spirits. The venue offers both indoor dining and an outdoor waterfront patio with panoramic harbour views, and hosts live music on Friday evenings. It draws a broad mix of locals and visitors, making it a natural destination for touring cyclists arriving at or departing from Victoria's waterfront.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible and corroborates all OSM contact details (phone 250-360-5873, address 100 Harbour Road Victoria BC V9A 0G1, email info@lurevictoria.com). The menu subpage explicitly labels vegetarian items with '(V)' (Lavender Yogurt Parfait, Avocado Toastie, Simple Start) and gluten-free items with '(GF)' (Open Faced Omelette), providing positive evidence for dietary options. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, takeout, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating waterfront restaurant and bar in Victoria with a fully active website, current menus, and all contact details confirmed; a natural stop for touring cyclists on the Inner Harbour.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu labels vegetarian dishes with (V) (e.g. Lavender Yogurt Parfait, Avocado Toastie, Simple Start) and gluten-free dishes with (GF) (e.g. Open Faced Omelette)
